answer_1.quote: We investigate the output of supervised and unsupervised MT systems of similar quality to assess whether systematic differences in translation exist...
datasets: WMT18 bitext (News Commentary v13, Europarl v7, Common Crawl, EU Press Release)
answer_1.outputs: German translations of English source sentences

answer_2.quote: We evaluate using BLEU, SacreBLEU, posTER (TER over POS tag sequences) and perplexity from language models...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation complements automatic evaluation... We hire 12 professional translators... Side-by-side Adequacy Raters see a source sentence with two translations... Side-by-side Fluency Raters assess the alternative translations without the source...
answer_4.guideline: Rate adequacy on a 0-100 scale and rate fluency/adequacy in side-by-side comparisons on a 6-point scale.
